milestone: House Gameplay Polish + Lilah Tornado V1
character: Existing Arianna Meshy skeleton; original character GLB unchanged

motion_assets.source: Carnegie Mellon University Motion Capture Database
motion_assets.license: CMU database terms: free for all uses, including inclusion in commercial products. The motion data itself may not be resold, including converted forms. This is not a CC0 declaration.
motion_assets.attribution: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
motion_assets.adaptation: ASF forward kinematics; root-relative hand trajectories, frames 180–539, 120 to 30 Hz; centered and normalized; loop seam blended over 0.2 seconds. Existing Meshy upper limbs retargeted with two-bone IK. Hand envelope and torso lean adjusted for floor wiping and vacuum handle height; locomotion, feet, character proportions and original GLB preserved. Existing pickup/putdown clips retained for object handling. Floor wiping includes a deep crouch using foot IK to preserve both original floor anchors.

audio_assets.usage: Reuses previously downloaded licensed assets for anticipation, cleanup, escalating streak, comic interruption and reward cues. Additional short synthesized notes are project-authored. No new music is played during the house event.

other_libraries_reviewed.decision: Reviewed interaction/tools packs; selected CMU's task-specific washing and sweeping capture for this milestone.
Reviewed reusable humanoid library; selected CMU cleaning captures. No Quaternius clips bundled.

reused_environment: Existing family pug and poop props; original sources and licenses remain in ASSET_SOURCES.md and public/asset-credits.html. Event toys, cloth, basket and juice are project-authored primitives.
